title: Northeastern churches (Suceava)
description: Churches in northeastern Romania, around Suceava (Bukovina), often have one or more central towers topped with an octagonal roof, and their roofs overhang the walls very widely.

title: Vâlcea and Gorj houses
description: Houses with stone foundations, small front staircases and façades with many window panes set in carved wooden frames are typically found in the hills on the western side of the southern plain, especially in Vâlcea and Gorj counties.

title: Green horizontal pole plate (Oltenia)
description: Romanian utility poles carry regional stickers. In Oltenia (southwest: Mehedinți, Gorj, Vâlcea, Argeș, Dolj, Olt, Teleorman) look for a small green horizontal plate showing the county abbreviation and a number (e.g. DJ for Dolj). The other two are a very long yellow sticker with the village name in the northeast (Moldavia) and a red-and-white electrical warning sign in the northwest.

title: Warning sticker on poles (northwest)
description: Romanian utility poles carry regional stickers. In the northwest (Satu Mare, Maramureș, Bihor, Sălaj, Cluj) look for a red-and-white electrical warning sign. The other two are a very long yellow sticker with the village name in the northeast (Moldavia) and a small green horizontal plate with the county abbreviation in Oltenia (southwest).

title: Long yellow pole sticker (northeast)
description: Romanian utility poles carry regional stickers. In the northeast (Suceava, Botoșani, Iași, Neamț, Bacău, Vaslui) look for a very long yellow sticker showing the name of the town or village. The other two are a red-and-white electrical warning sign in the northwest and a small green horizontal plate with the county abbreviation in Oltenia (southwest).
